Hi, @mxschmitt 
I tested the fix by using a mobile phone connected by USB to my local PC and it worked perfectly using the `@next` version.

But when I try to run the tests through the network to a remote android device (we have a few mobile devices used remotely for testing) I'm getting the same error (empty tracesDir). This is what is shown by the logcat of the mobile:

```
channel '9440f05  com.my.package/com.my.package.MainActivity (server)' ~ Channel is unrecoverably broken and will be disposed
```
_(this error multiple times)_

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6721904/155519907-d1a8bdd0-aa71-4c1f-a9d2-de8cb86de392.png)

The only difference between them is:
- The working one is directly connected to the mobile phone by USB connection.
- The one that is not working is connected by using `adb connect MOBILE_HOST_IP:PORT`

Do you have any idea of what is going on there? Sorry but I can't find what is the difference.

I found that the problem is at the page() function, the next one to awaiting the webview event.

Thank you.
Works for me! Maybe the Android devices has a too little android sdk version. Please open a separate issue, since I think the original issue has been solved.

Sure! I will create a new issue.

Thank you for your help!
